soldier: Head yellow, mandibles dark brown, thorax and abdomen white tinged with yellow. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides parallel. The frontal ridge is very slightly raised. The labrum is spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex narrowly rounded, bearing long apical hairs and short lateral-apical hairs. The mandibles are short and hook-like, the lacinial margin of the maxilla bearing about nine hairs. Antennae with 13–14 segments. The postmentum is narrow and long. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are almost straight, the middle of the anterior margin with a rather deep U-shaped notch, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave, the hairs of the middle region short, small and sparse.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.
